ClockOut helps you consciously close your workday and switch from work into your own time. It matters most when you work from home, where the boundary between the office and the living room is missing.

All it takes is a three-minute daily ritual: answer today's question and park a thought you no longer need to carry, calm your breath at 4s in / 4s out, tap to turn off the desk lamp, and note the mood you are leaving the day with.

Work stops spilling into your evening, you unwind more easily, and you start the next day rested. Everything stays on your phone — no accounts, no cloud.
